description: Every production release after the cutover: the fleet stays declared and built from source; no class may be created, deleted, renamed or transferred; no data resource deleted or replaced.

rollback.why: EXECUTOR_TELEMETRY holds the telemetry settings and, beside them, the release's build version, its commit, so it differs between any two releases. Cloudflare refuses to roll a Worker back across it without force, and the earlier version comes back with the value it ran with.
